name.description: EKS cluster name. Used as the suffix for IAM role names too (cluster-<name>, nodegroup-<name>). Must be unique within the AWS account.

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to us-east-1 — match the region of the VPC whose subnets you pass in spec.vpc.subnetIds. Cross-region EKS is not supported by this XRD.

version.description: Kubernetes control plane version. EKS supports the current minus three minor versions; bumping requires a node group AMI bump too. Defaults to "1.32" — keep in sync with terraform/management/variables.tf (kubernetes_version) so management and platform clusters share an upgrade cadence.

dns.description: DNS identity for the cluster. Services on the cluster are published at `<service>.<subdomain>.<domain>` and the cluster's wildcard ACM certificate covers `*.<subdomain>.<domain>`. The root `<domain>` and the Route53 zone are NOT set here — they are account- ephemeral (AGENTS §8.1) and injected from the base Terraform output via the `cluster-network` EnvironmentConfig (see ADR-e557a40123 / docs/decisions/ 0003). Only the stable per-cluster subdomain label lives in git.

subdomain.description: DNS label for this cluster under the root domain (e.g. "platform" → platform.<domain>; "workload1" → workload1.<domain>). ExternalDNS on the cluster is scoped to this subdomain and the wildcard ACM cert covers `*.<subdomain>.<domain>`.

nodeGroup.description: Managed node group sizing + instance choice.

instanceTypes.description: EC2 instance types the managed node group draws from. Defaults to t3.medium — sized for the 9-instance EC2 quota in this account. Use larger types in production-grade environments.

clusterArn.description: ARN of the EKS cluster once Active.

oidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Phase 3 creates the aws_iam_openid_connect_provider against this issuer so workloads on the cluster can use IRSA.

nodeGroupArn.description: ARN of the managed node group.

certificateArn.description: ARN of the cluster's wildcard ACM certificate (`*.<subdomain>.<domain>`) once ISSUED. Consumed by the cluster's ingress-nginx NLB (aws-load-balancer-ssl-cert annotation) to terminate TLS — no cert-manager / ACME on the cluster. Published by the acm Certificate MR.

certificateDomain.description: The wildcard domain the certificate covers (`*.<subdomain>.<domain>`), echoed for observability.

certValidationRecordFqdn.description: FQDN of the created validation record, fed to CertificateValidation.

clusterSecurityGroupId.description: EKS-managed cluster security group id (provider-emitted). Routed through the XR so the kube-relay-ingress rule can target it — admitting the ONE shared SSM relay (in the base VPC) to this cluster's private API endpoint on 443. The account's 9-instance cap rules out a per-cluster relay.

sandboxAccessEntryArn.description: ARN of the read-only EKS access entry for the sandbox identity.
